summary: A US gluten-free label allows how much gluten?

tiktok.text:
Gluten-free on a US label doesn't mean zero. Do you know the number? You get 5 seconds.

#glutenfree #foodlabels #foodtok #recipefix

instagram_reel.text:
Gluten-free on a US label doesn't mean zero. Do you know the number? You get 5 seconds.

Answer: Under 20 ppm. Gluten-free on a US label doesn't mean zero. The FDA rule caps it below 20 parts per million.
Source: FDA, Gluten-Free Labeling Q&A
